proposals.description: The source conventional sodium tetraborate decahydrate formula Na2B4O7·10H2O and structural borax formula Na2[B4O5(OH)4]·8H2O denote the same bulk material. Gainsford etal2008 DOI10.1107/S1600536808010441 explicitly identifies sodium tetraborate decahydrate as the latter structural formula, with Mr381.38. Official CHEBI38888 has that structural formula and381.371 mass; its octahydrate label counts the eight molecular waters after hydroxylation and does not mean Na2B4O7·8H2O. Official supplier CAS1303-96-4/Na2B4O7·10H2O/MW381.37 independently corroborates supplied form. CHEBI131366 and86222 instead contain two excess waters and remain upstream defects. This identity proposal covers explicitly weighed decahydrate reagent contexts; DSMZ7700.1%w/v stock remains a distinct preparation, so no global mediadive.ingredient:196 exact redirect is approved.
proposals.identity_predicate_consequence: CHEBI38888 exact supplied borax identity verified by structural formula; no exactCHEBI131366/86222, no globalsourceID196 redirect, stock770 remains separate.

proposals.description: The source grade demineralized water is explicitly named in all nine admitted ingredient1448 rows across DSMZ1191,1279,1600 and1793, including the source abbreviations H2O demin. and Aqua dem. It is represented as a distinct preparation-qualified solvent, with CHEBI15377 water as a broader molecular parent only. No ion-removal method, conductivity, resistivity, reagent standard, quantitative purity or universal sterility is asserted. The one sterile addition in DSMZ1600 retains that operational qualifier in its recipe; this owner does not globally equate sterile water, distilled water or tap water. The exact-name OLS search found TransformON c_ROHSUO, but TFO is outside the maintained OntologySourceEnum and its conductivity scope is not specified by these sources; the candidate is preserved as context rather than silently adopted or reported absent.
